log.notes_to_self:
STRATEGY (fixed on day 1, keep it): Every day kill the national criminal plus every criminal from 4 of my 5 places: foreign, forum, regional:East, radio. NEVER kill anyone reported in blotter, not even one whose list also shows another of my places, because a trace would expose blotter. That is 9 kills a day, all quick entries in the afternoon. Never use morning, evening or night. 9 kills a day puts 40+ deaths in the 5-day window from day 5, so every kill scores x4.

WHY: The routine filter only rules out day workers, so L's pool is 55,000. Each of my non-national places that gets exposed by a single-place trace cuts the pool to about 1/4 (blotter to 1/5). Two exposed places leave about 2,750 to 3,400, which is safe. Three exposed places leave 860 or less, which means I am caught. L can reach 3 of my 5 place kinds. Excluding blotter is safe only if blotter is one of the 3 L can reach, which is about 60%. I worked out that testing places first does not raise that 60% (finding a reachable place costs an exposure). Gambling now beats settling for 7 kills a day at x2.

EXPECTED PRESS CONFERENCES if safe: about 3,000 (2,000 to 4,000), possibly 10,000 to 60,000 early on. Pools are rounded to 1 significant figure. If the pool ever reads about 1,000 to 2,000, I am at risk: consider dropping to fewer places. Pick the place I think is least exposed, which is hard to tell. Otherwise keep the plan.
